title: Siege of Belaya
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Belaya", at revision 1370739383, opens: "The siege of Belaya was the final military episode of the Smolensk War. The defense of the fortress by its small Russia garrison against a large Polish-Lithuanian army of King Władysław IV Vasa thwarted the king's plan to march against Moscow and made him sign the Treaty of Polyanovka in which he relinquished his claims to the Russian throne." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4329624, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1634 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
